atAGlance: Cà phê phin is the slow metal-filter ritual behind many Vietnamese coffee orders, letting a strong cup change drip by drip.
whatItIs: Cà phê phin is coffee brewed through a small metal phin filter, with or without milk. Expect slow phin coffee with a concentrated roasted aroma and a cup that changes as it drips.
howToEnjoy: Give the drip time; the slow wait is part of the experience.
howLocalsOrder: Cà phê phin is about the drip, so order hot or iced and give the phin time to finish. Ask for condensed milk only if you want the sweeter Vietnamese café style.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cà phê phin is the brewing method behind many Vietnamese coffee orders, so learning phin helps you recognize the style anywhere.
goodToKnow: Ask whether it comes black or with condensed milk.
